failure_modes: Selecting C001-C003 would change the robust-delta curvature without any supplied evidence tying delta to the shape_xx/shape_yy endpoint contrast, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates for no demonstrated affinity gain.

Selecting C007-C009 would apply a temporal teacher blend beyond the observed support (observed score times end at 0.49) with no decoded terminal affinity labels, so any benefit claim would be unsupported and could displace coordinates on the strength of a diagnostic contrast.
Selecting C004-C006 would treat a teacher count as a distance bandwidth and alter teacher-mixture behavior that the supplied intramolecular/endpoint statistics do not characterize.
Any edit justified by survival, last-record or turnover credit would be invalid here because ancestral coverage is thin and terminal labels are undecoded (H002).
result.rationale: D1.1/D1.2: The only registered reward edits are pointcloud_delta_A (C001-C003), teacher_neighbors (C004-C006) and temporal_teacher_blend (C007-C009). None of these is a shape_xx/shape_yy contrast term; the executed pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment or geometry-block term, so no offered choice can directly oppose the negative shape contrast that H001 identifies as the highest-priority direction. C007-C009 change only the registered temporal blend of the same static teachers at observed score nodes (regional attention), not teacher coordinates and not a velocity target; the observed support ends at 0.49 while terminal credit lies beyond it, so a time-conditioned blend cannot be justified as an affinity benefit from the supplied evidence. D2.1/D2.2: The endpoint effects are integrated coordinate contrasts over the observed window, not spatial distance statistics, so they do not license a distance-response curvature or bandwidth change; teacher_neighbors is a count, not a bandwidth, and the fixed temperatures and teacher provenance must be preserved. D4.1/D4.2: The incumbent already sits at pointcloud_delta_A=1.0 and teacher_neighbors=4, and the information audit states its metrics are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and that teacher score correlations are observational, so no offered edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent. Retaining the incumbent is therefore the evidence-supported choice; a wrong edit would displace surrounding coordinates without a demonstrated affinity gain, and coordinate graph change alone is not a failure mechanism.
